meta.title: Tickets for the Space Show
meta.textType: functional: tickets and a notice with prices, dates, and times

paragraphs: Lily brings an invitation home from school. It is for the space festival at the school hall. It has a picture of a rocket. The festival has a space show on Saturday the twentieth of March. Lily is a member of the space club. Members of the club get a card. Tom wants to join the club too. Dad reads the invitation and smiles. "We should go," he says.

Dad takes Lily and Tom to the school hall. The notice on the door says, "The first show is at ten o'clock." It also says, "The second show is at a quarter past two." It says, "A child ticket is thirty baht, and an adult ticket is fifty baht." The show is a tour of a new planet. After the show, the children can visit the small school museum. Several families wait in a line at the table. The line is long.

"Which show shall we see?" asks Lily. "We should see the second show," says Dad. "Show two is later, so we can have lunch first." Lily is very happy. Dad buys one adult ticket and two child tickets. He gives one hundred and ten baht to a woman at the table. She gives him three tickets. "Thank you," says Dad.

At home, Lily writes the day and the hour in her calendar. Tom reads his ticket. Tom nods. "What time is show two?" he asks. "A quarter past two," says Lily. "We should arrive early," says Tom. "We will leave home at one o'clock," says Dad. Lily smiles and looks at her calendar. "I can't wait to see the planet!" she says.
text.summary: Dad buys tickets for the space show at the school hall. The notice gives the day, the times, and the prices, and Lily writes the date in her calendar.
